llm_response.reason: The website uses the name of a well-known fashion brand but on a non-official domain; it features extremely steep discounts, an implausibly broad product range, offers free shipping internationally with multi-currency pricing, and omits required legal/company/contact information. The WHOIS data is sparse or anonymized, and the official Van Laack website is different. All these are typical characteristics of a fake online shopping scam attempting to mimic a legitimate retailer.
